status: Prepared; final local and exact-source native/full-schema checks pending
boundaries: Explicit read-only transaction, bounded timeouts and access-share relation locks before full-visibility checks. No rows, schema, grants or worker state are changed.

Requires broad relation SELECT and inactive RLS for all source relations. Limited roles fail rather than returning hidden-row zeros. This is a trusted operator review script, not an endpoint or role grant.
Only fixed state labels, counts and fixed booleans are emitted. No IDs, paths, names, hashes, private text, source/result payloads or raw error messages are output.

Counts distinguish bound/unbound queued/processing/needs_review/completed/failed jobs, unknown states, invalid claim/lock shapes and retained identity conflicts. Historical unbound jobs still need review; no backfill is created.
Read-only row snapshots do not stop workers or prove absence. Quiescence, provider reconciliation, retention completion, rollout and cleanup authority stay false even for an empty database.

local_disposable_sql.skips: Real PostgreSQL concurrency cases only; no local concurrency proof.

limitations: This script requires the retained-source proposal, so it is not a pre-install scan for the unchanged hosted schema. A separate authorized pre-install plan and worker drain/reconciliation are still required.
Counts are one snapshot and cannot enumerate which exact private jobs need action. Any per-record review needs specifically authorized access and must not expose private payloads in CI artifacts.
No actual provider/Storage behavior, hosted worker pause/drain, migration, deployment/publication, AI/provider request, account/access/payment/secret or production action has occurred.
